title: Terrorsight
summary: Terrorsight is an illusory spell. It is used by the members of the Blood Spiral to show someone their greatest fear. The victim's eyes also glow as this happens.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Tantras used this spell on Zhalia Moon upon discovering her role as a Huntik Foundation spy. It forced her to drop her Logosbook which Tantras proceeded to pick up and read. [Sophie on Trial]

Harrison Fears used the spell at the Blood Spiral Base during a violent training session with a Silent Soldier. [Rassimov's Secret]

Harrison used the spell during his final battle with his brother Den Fears. It gave his Powerbonded Antedeluvian an opportunity to defeat Den's Cursed Archer. [Lok and the Betrayer]
